title: Matching puncture marks examined by Dr Margo

tellings.quote: and they're exactly the same depth and this and the same size
One more thing: I have two small puncture marks on my skin that I can’t explain. They’re identical; a perfectly round depression with a raised dimple in the center.

plain: A former Air Force guard at nuclear missile sites named Mario Woods says he carries two small puncture marks that a doctor he calls Dr Margo examined in 2019 on St. Simons Island, Georgia, and found 'exactly the same depth and this and the same size', a detail he connects to what he believes was his abduction by aliens. Woods relays this to Michels as what the doctor told him. An article by the journalist Robert Hastings, published in 2017 and telling the former missile guard's story, quotes him saying the marks are 'identical; a perfectly round depression with a raised dimple in the center.'
